Name: Harvest Moon Wizard Replacement
Author: TheMainFlamingoose
Description:
My favorite character from HM:AP has a much more interesting and attractive design from the wizard from Stardew Valley. He is well liked among many fans so I decided to contribute this. The files included replace the portraits and sprites for wizard. His name "Wizard" will remain the same. The new design is made in the vanilla art style.


The mod will contain two folders for the sprite and the portrait. 

To install the portrait: Simply drop the portrait xnb file into StardewValley>Content>Portraits. Replace the existing file.

To install the sprite: Drop the sprite xnb file into StardewValley>Content>Characters. Replace the existing file.

You're all done. Hope you enjoy. : )

If you have a mod such as Longevity, replace the sprites and portraits as necessary with these or the mod will override this one and you will not see Gale.
